**Verdict: PASS / NO BLOCKERS**

## Terminal review — round 2

Head: cde5443e307ee13f69028158abd68fe38f44c030
Reviewer: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, high (per the recorded launch header)

This verdict is conditional on green required CI at this head and completion of the planned final-head Nightly checks before merge.

**Blockers:** none.

**Nonblocking notes:** I accept the dispositions in the round comment. The previously recorded private-call differences remain outside the supported public-call guarantee. The isolated small-vector residual overhead remains recorded; the measured solve workloads meet the performance gate. The SIMD portability limitation remains recorded, with the planned Nightly dispatch at the final commit still required before merge. These dispositions do not waive a numerical or performance requirement.

**Verified:**

- Read the posted round 1 review and round 2 comment through `gh`; reviewed only the fix and its direct effects.
- Confirmed that the delta changes one file, `src/solvers/image_models.jl`, with exactly two deleted and two added comment lines. Removing full-line comments leaves identical file contents. No code, threshold, bound, test or documentation file changed.
- The corrected statement, “each underflowing square then loses at most floatmin(T) u”, includes the Float32 midpoint equality established in round 1. For the supported nonempty operands, the guard gives `u s / length(a) >= 4 floatmin(T) u > floatmin(T) u`. Thus the following strict inequality and the existing relative-error margin remain valid for both norm forms. No broader claim introduced by this correction was found.
- The comment scanner returned zero candidates; manual review covered the entire changed sentence and its surrounding proof. `git diff --check` passed. The tracked checkout is clean. No Julia run or test file was needed for this comment-only delta; round 1 numerical and performance evidence remains applicable to the unchanged code. No tracked file was changed and nothing was posted to GitHub.

**Earlier findings:**

1. Round 1 blocker 1, P2 proof comment at `src/solvers/image_models.jl:97-98`: **fixed** at this head. No earlier blocker remains open; none was withdrawn. The nonblocking-note dispositions are accepted as stated above.

**CI:** pending on this exact head. `gh pr checks 362` reports the full Linux test tier, benchmark controls, merge gate and documentation still running; the test-plan check passed. Both [CI](https://github.com/mlakolar/ProximalSolvers.jl/actions/runs/44248895297) and [Documentation](https://github.com/mlakolar/ProximalSolvers.jl/actions/runs/44248895258) were verified to target this SHA. The planned Nightly dispatch remains outstanding.
